; Paper Pro 3.29 toolbar integration. Two native toolbar slots, hidden by its own toggle.
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        REPLACE showableToolsCount WITH {
            readonly property int showableToolsCount: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Math.max(innerWidth, innerHeight) / ArkTokens.Style.variable.controlsHeight.large) - 3)
        }
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            XoviMessageBroker { id: replyBroker }


            QtObject {
                id: replyState
                property bool busy: false
                property bool autoSend: false
                property bool monitorReady: false
                property bool failed: false
                property string message: "ChatGPT"
            }
            Timer {
                interval: 500
                repeat: true
                running: root.visible
                onTriggered: {
                    try {
                        var result = JSON.parse(replyBroker.sendSimpleSignal("reply$status", ""));
                        var completed = replyState.busy && !result.busy;
                        replyState.busy = result.busy;
                        replyState.message = result.message;
                        replyState.autoSend = result.autoSend;
                        replyState.monitorReady = result.monitorReady;
                        if (result.busy) replyState.failed = false;
                        if (completed) {
                            var quiet = /^(Writing continued|Cancelled|Canceled|Page changed|Answer written|Answer added|Web answer|Grayscale image added|Diagram added|Plot added)/i.test(result.message);
                            replyState.failed = !quiet;
                        }
                    } catch (error) {
                        replyState.busy = false;
                        replyState.message = "Ink Diary extension unavailable";
                        replyState.failed = true;
                    }
                }
            }

        }
        TRAVERSE Item#toolbar > GridLayout#toolLayout
            LOCATE BEFORE Repeater#secondaryTools
            INSERT {
                ArkControls.ToolButton {
                    id: replyAutoButton
                    objectName: "reply-auto-button"
                    visible: root.expanded
                    focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                    background: Rectangle { color: replyState.autoSend ? "black" : "white" }
                    contentItem: Item {
                        Image {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            width: 44
                            height: 44
                            source: replyState.autoSend ? "file:///home/root/.config/reply/detect-active.svg" : "file:///home/root/.config/reply/detect.svg"
                            sourceSize.width: 44
                            sourceSize.height: 44
                            opacity: replyState.monitorReady ? 1 : 0.4
                        }
                    }
                    onClicked: {
                        var result = JSON.parse(replyBroker.sendSimpleSignal("reply$auto", ""));
                        replyState.autoSend = result.autoSend;
                    }
                    PenInputBlocker { anchors.fill: parent; enabled: true; manager: root.penInput.surfaceManager }
                }
                ArkControls.ToolButton {
                    id: replyAnswerButton
                    objectName: "reply-answer-button"
                    visible: root.expanded
                    focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                    background: Item {}
                    contentItem: Item {
                        Image {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            width: 44
                            height: 44
                            source: "file:///home/root/.config/reply/wand.svg"
                            sourceSize.width: 44
                            sourceSize.height: 44
                            visible: !replyState.busy
                        }
                        Rectangle {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            width: 28
                            height: 28
                            color: "black"
                            visible: replyState.busy
                        }
                        // A failed request is indicated in the control itself;
                        // never cover notebook content with technical messages.
                        Rectangle {
                            anchors.right: parent.right
                            anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                            width: 18
                            height: 18
                            radius: 9
                            color: "black"
                            visible: replyState.failed && !replyState.busy
                            Text {
                                anchors.centerIn: parent
                                text: "!"
                                color: "white"
                                font.pixelSize: 14
                                font.bold: true
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    onClicked: {
                        replyState.failed = false;
                        if (replyState.busy) {
                            replyBroker.sendSimpleSignal("reply$cancel", "");
                        } else {
                            replyState.busy = true;
                            replyBroker.sendSimpleSignal("reply$start", "");
                        }
                    }
                    PenInputBlocker { anchors.fill: parent; enabled: true; manager: root.penInput.surfaceManager }
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
